caption.text:
Literally living my dream life. 🥹🤎 

Follow @hereverydaymotherhood for more relatable everyday motherhood + marriage moments 🤍

latest_comments: I never made any sacrifices. My kids are now 43 and 41 and I’d do it the same all over again.
Being a Mom is my whole life, my greatest joy and my greatest happiness! My youngest graduates high school next week and I feel lost🥲
I used to view sacrifice as something bad/ undesirable because you're giving something up, but now I see it as giving up something good for something better. And when I frame it that way,

Absolutely none. Being home 24/7 to raise them with the Man who is the answered prayer I get to call my Husband and who they get to call Daddy is the most incredible dream I get to call my blessed reality. It’s unreal this is our life. Glory to God.
I work at a college and see people go back to school way into middle age and older all the time. Go pursue your dreams now
